author: Alex Brown
title: Hoosier Companies Among 'Most Admired'
text:
Hoosier Companies Among 'Most Admired' Posted: Simon Property Group is one of two Indiana companies on the list. INDIANAPOLIS and FORT WAYNE -
Two Indiana companies are included in Fortune's 2019 list of the "World's Most Admired Companies." The list was determined by a survey of nearly 4,000 executives, directors and analysts who rated companies in their own industries based on criteria such as investment value, quality of management and ability to attract talent.
Indianapolis-based Simon Property Group Inc. (NYSE: SPG) and Fort Wayne-based Steel Dynamics Inc. (Nasdaq: STLD) are the two Indiana representatives on the list. However, there are no Indiana companies on the top 50 "All-Stars" rankings.
More than 50 industries are represented on the list. The companies included on the list were selected from a pool of about 1,500 candidates. The top 5 companies on the list are: Apple Inc. Indianapolis-based Books & Brews has announced its acquisition of Flat12 Bierwerks, also based in Indy. Financial terms of the deal are not being disclosed, however Books & Brews says it will continue to operate Flat12 under the same brand name. The acquisition is a continuation of an existing partnership between the two entities. Books & Brews says Flat12 has been a brewery partner for the past two years, brewing all of B&B's flagship and seasonal beers. By Alex Brown Multimedia Journalist 2019-01-22T01:48:46Z
